notes: the two heads «يحيى بن يحيى، ومحمد بن رمح» are co-transmitters of one level, joined by «قالا»; the second route (قتيبة بن، سعيد) meets them at Laith; «ليث» is occurrence 2 (occurrence 1 sits inside «الليث»)
«نافع» and «عبد الله» are written once after Laith; «عبد الله» is written bare and not completed (rule 9)
the Prophet's «فأنكر» is the saying's subject, not a link
